channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Billy King | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Billy King from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

Adam Silver on Billy King, Feb 24, 2014. Source: Bleacher Report.

item.title: Mikhail Prokhorov on Avery Johnson, Joe Johnson, Bobby Marks, Deron Williams, Billy King
item.description:
Prokhorov said in the statement.

“My congratulations and appreciation go out to general manager Billy King, assistant general manager Bobby Marks and head coach Avery Johnson for their tenacity, nerve and heart throughout this process. With the re-signing of Deron Williams and the trade for Joe Johnson, we go into our new home led by an All-Star backcourt and with every hope of a great season for the Brooklyn Nets. I can’t wait until opening night.”

Mikhail Prokhorov on Avery Johnson, Joe Johnson, Bobby Marks, Deron Williams, Billy King, Jul 13, 2012. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Mikhail Prokhorov on Joe Johnson, Bobby Marks, Deron Williams, Billy King
item.description:
Mikhail Prokhorov:

“I'm thrilled with the way our team has come together. My congratulations and appreciation go out to General Manager Billy King, Assistant General Manager Bobby Marks and Head Coach Avery Johnsonfor their tenacity, nerve and heart throughout this process. With the re-signing of Deron Williams and the trade for Joe Johnson, we go into our new home led by an All-Star backcourt and with every hope of a great season for the Brooklyn Nets. I can't wait until opening night.”

Mikhail Prokhorov on Joe Johnson, Bobby Marks, Deron Williams, Billy King, Jul 12, 2012. Source: Sulia.

item.title: Avery Johnson on Mikhail Prokhorov, Billy King
item.description:
Avery Johnson:

“So we’re here evaluating all of these kids, we’re going through the interview process just like all of the other teams. So even though we’re at 57 now, my general manager is Billy King and Mikhail Prokhorov is the owner so you never know what they may pull off. So we’re anticipating that we could move up.”

Avery Johnson on Mikhail Prokhorov, Billy King, Jun 7, 2012. Source: ZagsBlog.com.

item.title: Larry Brown on Billy King, Quin Snyder
item.description:
“I tried to recruit Tommy, Billy King, Quin Snyder, a lot of them. But when (Amaker) was at Michigan, he let me come and hang out at his practices, so this is more of the same. I’m going to (Kansas) next week. I’ve been speaking a lot — Villanova and Rutgers. I hang out in Philadelphia, so I’ve been at Villanova a lot.”

Larry Brown on Billy King, Quin Snyder, Oct 28, 2011. Source: Boston Herald.

item.title: Avery Johnson on Troy Murphy, Billy King
item.description:
Relaying a message from GM Billy King, Johnson said Wednesday that he expects all his players to remain with the club past Feb. 24.Only Troy Murphy, who requested a trade and has not been with the team since last month, is on Johnson’s departure radar.

“I know Billy (King) is hoping to do something with Murphy and I hope that happens because Murphy’s a good kid and it hadn’t worked out here,”

Avery Johnson on Troy Murphy, Billy King, Feb 18, 2011. Source: New York Daily News.

item.title: Mikhail Prokhorov on Billy King
item.description:

“I am very pleased Billy King is coming on board as Nets general manager,”

Mikhail Prokhorov on Billy King, Jul 14, 2010. Source: Bergen Record.
